needs_result.text: Integrated the agent into a React front end with real-time gene alias enrichment.

Proposed the request flow: a user's text goes through the API and a customised prompt to the MCP server, where one LLM instance writes GraphQL queries against the client's Convex database and a second instance runs the statistical analysis before the result returns to the user.

Designed reproducible scikit-learn pipelines with feature engineering (temporal features, interaction terms, target encoding), model selection, cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning across classification and regression tasks.

Working independently for India-based startups and individual clients, built agentic RAG workflows (LangChain, LangGraph, ChromaDB) on GCP Cloud Run, NLP pipelines (Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama) and scikit-learn pipelines, served ML models as REST APIs (FastAPI, Docker), and contributed to a team LoRA fine-tune of a Llama model.
Predicted bank-customer churn with a supervised XGBoost propensity classifier in R (tidymodels): two-stage Bayesian hyperparameter tuning, SMOTE inside the preprocessing recipe and MCC evaluation.

bullets.text: Predicted bank-customer churn with a supervised XGBoost propensity classifier in R (tidymodels): two-stage Bayesian hyperparameter tuning, SMOTE inside the preprocessing recipe and MCC evaluation.

Built a tool-calling LLM agent (LangChain, AWS Bedrock, Claude Haiku 4.5) for a multi-omics cancer research platform, with three tools for gene alias resolution, scoring-methodology explanation and dataset provenance.

Needed an agent that researchers could trust on a cancer research platform, including when its tools fail: built a tool-calling agent (LangChain, Claude Haiku 4.5 on AWS Bedrock) for three use cases (gene alias resolution, prompt-engineered explanations of a fixed scoring pipeline, validated dataset descriptions), with deterministic Ensembl and HGNC calls, deterministic hallucination guards, and circuit breakers with a 19,213-gene parquet fallback for when the external APIs are unavailable.
Designed a deterministic hallucination-guard architecture and fail-safe data resolution via live Ensembl/HGNC APIs with a local 19,213-gene parquet fallback and circuit breakers.

Wrote a three-tier test framework (tool-level, API/integration, live agent) of ~65 tests across 8 files, validated across the LLM provider migration from Groq to AWS Bedrock after a rate-limit evaluation.

Diagnosed where it struggled with a three-tier, ~65-test evaluation harness (tool-level → API → live) and hallucination-rate analysis, debugging failures layer by layer, and used the same harness to validate the Groq to Bedrock migration after a rate-limit evaluation.
Built NLP and agentic RAG workflows with Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, LangChain and LangGraph.
Built a production RAG and agentic retrieval system (Claude API, LangChain, LangGraph, ChromaDB) served through a FastAPI REST API in Docker on GCP Cloud Run.

As a trainee, modelled user-profile, transaction-history and event-booking data in Core Data schemas with CRUD and session-state management, and automated a manual data-collection process with a JavaScript web-scraping pipeline that surfaced market-trend signals used for pricing decisions.
Wrote the dissertation's AI-agent sections covering architecture, implementation and evaluation, including a documented hallucination-rate analysis and test-case outcomes.

skills.Agentic AI & LLM Applications: Tool calling and failure recovery (LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, ReAct agent loops; circuit breakers, fallbacks, deterministic guardrails), multi-provider LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude on AWS Bedrock, Google Gemini via LiteLLM, open-weight models via Ollama), LLM evaluation (three-tier tests, hallucination-rate analysis), agent memory (persistent storage and retrieval across sessions), RAG pipelines (retrieval, generation, embeddings and the ChromaDB vector database), MCP servers (FastMCP, TypeScript SDK), prompt engineering, AI-assisted development (Claude Code as primary tool, Cursor, OpenAI Codex)
skills.Software Engineering & Integrations: TypeScript/Node.js, React, Python, JavaScript, FastAPI, Pydantic, RESTful APIs and third-party API integrations, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, SQL, MongoDB and DynamoDB (NoSQL), graph data (networkx), pytest, Git (pull requests, code review), debugging and root-cause analysis
skills.Cloud & Deployment: AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, ECR, S3, SQS, EC2, IAM, Cognito), GCP (Cloud Run), Docker, Kubernetes (AWS EKS), GitHub Actions CI/CD, serverless deployment
